text_block_list.text:
On my way home from shopping with<n>Biwa
Hayahide, we hear lively<n>singing coming from
somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the poster over there, it<n>looks like a
concert's being held<n>nearby.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Woohoo! Flying in from out of<n>nowhere, it's
Tokaaai Teiooo!

text_block_list.name: Idols
text_block_list.text:
Wooo! Everyone's so hyped up!<n>We're not losing
to you, though! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
T-Teio? What is she doing up there,<n>dancing with
those idols?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Did you see how she moved? She<n>was so elegant
and expressive... She<n>fits right in with the other
professionals on stage.
choice_data_list: She was definitely pretty into it.
She was definitely pretty into it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ngh... I feel so ashamed of myself.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Compared to her, I'm stiff as a board<n>when I
dance. There's no way my<n>clumsy moves are
conveying my<n>gratitude to the fans...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There must be some trick to being<n>able to dance so
well.
choice_data_list: Why don't you try dancing with her?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course! That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Your performance was superb, Teio. I<n>enjoyed it
immensely.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thank you! Hehe! Seeing them<n>dance made me
all giddy, so I decided<n>to jump on up there!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You truly did! I was wondering if—no,<n>wait. I need to
approach this more<n>respectfully...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Miss Teio, would you please teach<n>me the secret to
dancing confidently?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Miss Teio?! Aw, gosh, you don'thave to be that respectful! But Iguess I am a pretty good dancer...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Please, I implore you! You must teach<n>me how to
dance without looking like<n>I'm made out of wood!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You're not... really made out of wood,<n>are you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but whatever! For<n>starters, why
don't you show me<n>some moves?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Uh... Right here?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm your teacher now, so you<n>gotta listen to
me! Come on, copy my<n>steps!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: A-am I doing this correctly?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, look at you! You definitely seem<n>like the real
deal to me! Your height<n>makes your moves super
dynamic<n>too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You've got a lot going for you, so<n>don't worry! As
your teacher, I think<n>you'll be fine as long as you
polish<n>up those skills of yours!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I understand now... So I have my very<n>own way of
expressing myself!

Thanks to Tokai Teio's<n>encouragement and help,
Biwa<n>Hayahide's dance moves improve<n>greatly!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you want to go up and dance<n>too? Nice! Go
ahead! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: W-wait, I never said I wanted to—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Hayahide! Let me guess. You<n>can't resist the
beat either, huh?

text_block_list.name: Idols
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Come on, show us your moves!<n>Get over here
and let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gah! How did this happen?

text_block_list.name: Idols
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My heart is filled with so much<n>love, love,
looove! All for you, you,<n>youuu! Woo! ♪

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: W-woo...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Awww, you're sooo cute! C'mon,<n>you've gotta
dance with everyone!<n>Encore! Encore!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, that was fun! Nothing relaxes me<n>like a good
dance sesh!
choice_data_list: You were both fantastic up there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... You really... think so? Iactually got... pretty absorbed in it,myself...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You were perfect! All the fans lovedyou! Dancing is all about feeling!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Think about it—the reason why we<n>dance at our
winning concerts is<n>because we want to make our
fans<n>happy, right?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah! Yes, now that you mention it...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I guess the secret to dancing<n>confidently was
inside me the whole<n>time.

Biwa Hayahide's worries melt away,<n>and her
dance moves improve<n>greatly.
